incidents_catalogued.title: Initial Model State Randomly Initialized Violating Pretrained Backbone Invariant INV-10
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: Model initialized from ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1 under canonical protocol.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: data/ops02/initial_model_state.pt (SHA256: 4BB233DB629E44DE12E41F11809024B7A5BDA4DBCFB19D13752295973117E45C) bitwise matches an un-pretrained (pretrained=False) ResNet18UNet initialized under seed 42. It contains zero ImageNet-pretrained weights. The required pretrained weights file resnet18-f37072fd.pth was downloaded dynamically on Kaggle during C16, but is not present in local torch hub cache (~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints) and cannot be downloaded under strict offline governance.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Conflation of pairwise control/treatment parity (both conditions initialized identically) with canonical protocol initialization provenance (starting state matches ImageNet-pretrained protocol).
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Classified current initial_model_state.pt as NON_CANONICAL_INITIALIZATION_ARTIFACT. Superseded C22-A.2 readiness verdict to BLOCKED. Formulated Lesson LL-EXP07-024 to permanently prevent pairwise parity from masking non-canonical initialization.

remediation_summary: EXP07_DIAG01 is formally BLOCKED from training authorization until the canonical ImageNet-pretrained weights (resnet18-f37072fd.pth) are properly provisioned and verified locally.
